name: Obeah — 3 Advanced — Unburdening the Bestial Soul

system.description: By making eye contact with a willing subject and winning a Static Physical Challenge scaled to their lost Humanity, you draw their soul into communion with your own to heal psychic trauma, allowing Willpower Traits to be spent to restore Humanity or Path Traits up to the normal maximum.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
